# Synthetic fixtures

T04 will generate small, visibly synthetic fixtures with explicit provenance.
T03's `synthetic/pixel.ppm` is an owned two-pixel schema/hash fixture, not a
renderer fixture or approved artwork. Migration and snapshot data generated by
unit tests are also explicitly synthetic.
T02's bounded scene inputs are generated under temporary/local run directories
by `tabi.core.render.synthetic`; the watermarked output verifies tools and is
not the reusable T04 asset pack. No generated MP4 is a committed fixture.
The artwork in `docs/assets/` is reference material and is not a test fixture or
an approved production pack. MP4 files must remain untracked.
